_comment: Metrics the predictive layer watches. 'direction' is which way is bad: 'above' means predict when the metric will exceed limit, 'below' means predict when it will drop below limit. horizon_hours caps how far into the future a prediction is allowed to look -- forecasts further out than this are too uncertain to act on, so predictor.py drops them rather than showing a false sense of precision.
